# gitmoap_repository_pipeline_file (Data Source)

Read one pipeline's files at a ref. Every file of the directory that declares the pipeline, as committed — the steps it runs may be written in any of them — the pipeline they declare with its names bound to what they name in your organization now, and every diagnostic with its file, line and column. Reads the default branch unless a ref or a commit is named — never both.

The token needs `pipeline:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_pipeline_file" "api" {
  pipeline_name = "deploy"
  repo_id       = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pipeline_name` (String) The pipeline's name: its `pipeline` block's label, or a `.json` file's name without the extension
- `repo_id` (String) Repository id

### Optional

- `commit_sha` (String) A commit to read instead of a ref's tip
- `ref` (String) A branch, a tag or a full ref; the default branch when absent

### Read-Only

- `blob_sha` (String) The git object id of the file its block is in — what a commit that edits it names as
`expected_blob_sha`.
- `definition` (Attributes) A pipeline definition to create, or to replace an existing one with in full. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition))
- `diagnostics` (Attributes List) Every problem the pipeline has and everything worth saying about it, file by file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics))
- `directory` (String) The directory its namespace is.
- `files` (Attributes List) Every file of its namespace, as committed — the steps it runs may be written in any of
them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String) The file its `pipeline` block is in, from the repository's root.
- `pipeline_id` (String)
- `text` (String) The file its block is in, as committed.

<a id="nestedatt--definition"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition`

Read-Only:

- `component_instances` (Attributes List) Components this pipeline uses. Each expands into ordinary steps and connections before the
pipeline is validated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--component_instances))
- `description` (String)
- `edges` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--edges))
- `name` (String)
- `stages` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--stages))
- `status` (String) Whether a pipeline definition can run. A `draft` is saved even when it is invalid — problems are
reported, not refused — and cannot be run; a `published` definition must be valid to be saved,
and can be run.

<a id="nestedatt--definition--component_instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.component_instances`

Read-Only:

- `component_id` (String)
- `component_ref` (String) The reference as the author wrote it, kept for display. It is not used to find the
component.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String) Display name, also put in front of the display names of the steps it expands into.
- `stage_map` (Map of String) Maps every stage slot the component declares to a stage of this pipeline, keeping the slots'
order.
- `version` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--definition--edges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.edges`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `source_node_id` (String)
- `source_port` (String)
- `target_node_id` (String)
- `target_port` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--definition--stages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.stages`

Read-Only:

- `barrier_mode` (String) When a stage is allowed to start. `strict` waits for every step in every earlier stage to finish, so a failure anywhere stops what follows. `lenient` waits only for the steps a given step actually depends on, so an unrelated branch failing does not block it. `strict` is the default.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--stages--nodes))
- `stage_type` (String) The pipeline stage a capability belongs to. Maps verbatim to the
`stage_type` field of a capability in `gitmoap-provider.yaml`.

<a id="nestedatt--definition--stages--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.stages.nodes`

Read-Only:

- `allow_failure` (Boolean) When `true`, this node's failure (a non-zero exit or a timeout, after any
retries) is non-blocking: it does not fail the enclosing stage or the run.
The node's transitive dependents — which can never receive its output —
are skipped, while independent branches and later stages keep running. A
run whose only failures were `allow_failure` nodes finishes
`succeeded_with_warnings`.
- `approval` (Attributes) An approval gate on a step. With no `approvers`, anyone with Developer access to the repository
may decide; a list narrows the decision to the people, teams and roles it names, as they stand
when the approval is given. On a step that deploys to an environment requiring approval, the
list may only name approvers the environment also names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--stages--nodes--approval))
- `capability_id` (String)
- `changes` (List of String) Path globs that decide whether this step runs: when none of them matches a path the push
changed, the step is skipped. When absent and `service` is set, the service's own path globs
apply.
- `connection` (String)
- `cpu` (String)
- `environment` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `max_retries` (Number)
- `memory` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `resource_group` (Attributes) A resource group a step holds while it runs, so only one step naming it runs at a time. Unless
`mode` says otherwise, a step queues for the group, for as long as the pipeline's timeout
allows unless `max_wait_seconds` sets a shorter limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--definition--stages--nodes--resource_group))
- `retry_delay_seconds` (Number)
- `service` (String)
- `timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `variables_from` (String)
- `version` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--definition--stages--nodes--approval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.stages.nodes.approval`

Read-Only:

- `required` (Number) Distinct approvals needed, 1–10. On a gated environment the larger of this and the
environment's own count applies.


<a id="nestedatt--definition--stages--nodes--resource_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `definition.stages.nodes.resource_group`

Read-Only:

- `max_wait_seconds` (Number)
- `mode` (String) What happens when a run wants to deploy while another run holds the lock: `queue` (the
default) waits its turn, `skip` skips the step, and `cancel_previous` cancels the other run.
`cancel_previous` is available on environments only, not on a step's resource group.
- `name` (String)





<a id="nestedatt--diagnostics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `diagnostics`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) A stable code: a `syntax_*`, `unsupported_*`, `schema_*` or `reference_*` code of the
language, or a pipeline validation rule's own name.
- `fix` (Attributes) A replacement that fixes a diagnostic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--fix))
- `location` (Attributes) A span of a file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--location))
- `message` (String) What is wrong, in a sentence that names it.
- `related` (Attributes List) Other places that matter to it — the other half of a duplicate, the rest of a cycle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--related))
- `severity` (String) How serious a diagnostic is.
- `target` (String) The element it is about, as `step:<id>`, `stage:<id>`, `edge:<id>` or `component:<id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--diagnostics--fix"></a>
### Nested Schema for `diagnostics.fix`

Read-Only:

- `fix_location` (Attributes) A span of a file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--fix--fix_location))
- `text` (String) The text to put there.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:
